**File Location:** `vapi/resources/views/index.html:16`  

## Description

Properties are copied from [i](1) to [t](2) without guarding against prototype pollution.

## Remediation

Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.
